## Install

1. Download **NotchPilot.dmg** below.
2. Open it and drag **NotchPilot** into **Applications**.
3. Open NotchPilot from Applications. A short setup walks you through your AI key, your resume, and permissions.

**"Apple could not verify NotchPilot"?** NotchPilot isn't signed with a paid Apple Developer ID yet. Open **System Settings › Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway**. You only do this once.

Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later. Works on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
